claims.claim: composition state runs prompt/agent/tool/branch/parallel steps and produces structured output instead of an LLM-driven turn
CompositionStage replaces ProviderStage; reads the turn's user message as input, walks the DAG, emits output as the turn response
state store, events, eval hooks, guardrails remain unchanged
Output is validated structured JSON
agent step: tool loop terminates at max_steps or when tool_called fires
agent tool access is the intersection of the prompt's allowed tools and the step's tools list
prompt step runs prompt assembly + one LLM call, no tool loop
tool step invokes a registry tool directly with args
branch routes to then/else step ids; else optional; if omitted and predicate false, execution skips to next sequential step
predicate operators: equals,not_equals,in,not_in,less_than,less_than_or_equals,greater_than,greater_than_or_equals,exists
compound predicates use all_of, any_of, not
parallel runs two or more branch steps concurrently and merges outputs
reduce.strategy: barrier (wait for all, merge), append (concatenate), replace (last write wins)
reduce.into names the key under which the merged result is available as ${meta.output.metadata}
${input.X} and ${stepID.output.X} references; literal object mixing references
Both prompt and agent steps accept a modifiers block
retry.max_attempts retries the step on transient failure
modifiers.eval runs the listed pack evals against the step's output; observability only
compositions: top-level under spec, sibling of workflow; state fields orchestration: composition and composition: <name>; prompt_task omitted
composition fields input_schema, output_schema
output: final step id; defaults to last step if omitted
unresolved composition reference is a hard error
composition no state references produces a warning
depends_on is required on steps that join after a branch or parallel
Send on a composition state runs CompositionStage; resp.CompositionOutput() returns the output
sdk.OpenWorkflow(path, sdk.WithProvider(p)) returns a conversation with Send(ctx, msg)
OpenComposition(packPath, name, opts...) runs a named composition directly
conv.OnTool(name, func(args map[string]any)(any,error))
Send input: JSON object text is the composition input
mock provider looks up per-step responses by step id from a steps: map next to turns:, steps take priority over turns, fall back to scenario default
steps entry keys response and tool_calls (name, arguments)
four handlers composition_step_output, composition_branch_taken, composition_parallel_complete, composition_output
handler params: step+contains; branch+expected; parallel; contains
threshold judgment lives on the type: assertion wrapper
unsupported: loops, kinds judge/refine/subflow/speculate/pause, step timeout/on_error/budget, durable execution, A2A delegation
a prompt or agent step runs on the provider named by its provider key, bound with sdk.WithNamedProvider
